Market today:
Cautious mood. AI stocks are sliding, and rising Treasury yields nearing 5% are putting pressure on growth-oriented tech names. Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are also driving oil prices higher, adding to market uncertainty.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-52.13%) and SPAL (-30.89%) are in "SELL" status, deeply in the red, and are leveraged ETFs, meaning drawdowns hurt extra on margin. QQQI (-3.28%) is also flagged for "TRIM." SMH is down too.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on further developments in the Middle East and how oil prices react. Also, monitor the Fed's stance on rates and the 10-year Treasury yield.

Bottom line:
Focus on managing your high-risk leveraged positions and be cautious with tech given current headwinds.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL (-52.13%) and SPAL (-30.89%) given their leveraged nature and "SELL" status, especially with AI stocks sliding.
Watch QQQI (-3.28%) for a trim as an income anchor, per its scanner status.
For a new idea, XOM (scanner BUY 9/12, entry 165.47-165.28, stop 164.77) looks interesting with rising oil prices from Middle East tensions.
